title: What is the average attendance of meetings in 2020?
question: What is the average attendance of meetings in 2020?

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT AVG(T2.amount)
FROM event_attendance AS T1
JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event
WHERE T1.type = 'Meeting'
  AND SUBSTR(T1.event_date, 1, 4) = '2020'

base_solution_anchor.base_sql: SELECT AVG(meeting_attendance) FROM (SELECT COUNT(link_to_member) AS meeting_attendance FROM event_attendance WHERE event_date LIKE '2020%' GROUP BY event_id)
